name: AvatarRoot
description: Avatar component for displaying a user's profile image with an automatic initial-based fallback. Renders a `<span>` element.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the avatar border radius. Default: `'square'`

props.name: size
props.description:
Size of the avatar. Controls the width, height, and border radius. Default: `'md'`
Size of the fallback content. Controls the font size, line height, font weight, and letter spacing. Default: `'md'`

props.name: onLoadingStatusChange
props.description: Callback fired when the loading status changes.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long to wait before showing the fallback. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Whether the image element stays mounted and loads in place instead of being preloaded.
Supports `loading="lazy"` and optimized image components such as `next/image`.

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
Accepts a ReactElement or a function that returns the element to render.
